summary: Every 666 you see doubles your Symbols Multiplier for the rest of that Round.
tip: Force a 666 early in a Round with Possessed Cell Phone, then play the rest doubled. Holy Bible or Rosary cancel the coin loss and it still triggers; 999s count in Sacred Mode.

synergies.why: Forces the 666 on demand, ideally on the first spin of a Round.
A cancelled 666 still doubles your Symbols Multiplier, without losing the Round's coins.
Each 666 also grants bonus spins, all played at the doubled multiplier.
Fires off the same 666: tripled gems on top of a doubled multiplier.
More natural 666s plus Patterns Multiplier +2.
Doubles the 666 chance and your Symbols Multiplier on top of this.

assumptions: Assumed a second 666 in the same Round doubles again (x4).
Wiki notes: charms triggered by 666 still trigger when Holy Bible cancels the 666 (no Cadaver Piece then); the Golden Horseshoe note says the same for Rosary, so both are synergies, not clashes.

summary: Red Button (3 charges): guarantees a 666 on your next spin, from Deadline 3 on. Turns 666-payoff charms into on-demand power.
tip: Press it before a Round's first spin so the 666 wipes almost nothing (deposit first from Deadline 7). Holy Bible cancels the loss while Baphomet and Gabihbb'h still trigger.

effects.text: Red Button: your next spin shows a guaranteed 666 (only from Deadline 3 onwards). Presses stack, so several 666s can be queued.

The forced 666 acts like a normal one: it wipes the coins earned this Round (Deadlines 3-6) or all coins in hand (Deadline 7+), drops a Cadaver Piece in a drawer (replacing a stored charm if all drawers are full; not if Holy Bible cancels it), and a 666 in the Round before you answer the phone turns that call Red.

synergies.why: Every forced 666 permanently doubles the Above and Below Patterns.
Cancels the forced 666's coin loss while 666 charms still trigger; the Bible breaks half the time.
Doubles your Symbols Multiplier for the rest of the Round.
Each 666 hands out bonus spins (+3, then +2, then +1 per Round).
Triples Diamond, Treasure and Seven values for the rest of the Round.
Each press triggers twice, queuing two 666s.

assumptions: Unclear whether stacked presses put several 666s on one spin or one 666 on each following spin.
Assumed Holy Bible and Rosary can cancel the forced 666 like a natural one.
Wiki notes: 666 charms still trigger when Holy Bible (or Rosary) cancels the 666, so protection removes the coin loss.
A community note pairs it with Baphomet and Nuclear Button once Sacred Mode is unlocked (6s become coin-doubling 999s); not verified, so not claimed.

summary: After a 666, Lemon and Cherry Patterns trigger one extra time for the rest of that Round.

synergies.why: Forces the 666 on demand, early in the Round.
A cancelled 666 still adds the fruit retrigger, without losing the Round's coins.
The bonus spins after each 666 all get the fruit retrigger.
Fruit Patterns already trigger again; this adds one more.
Repetition fruit and the Tomato retrigger stack.
More Lemon Patterns to retrigger.

summary: Doubles Symbols and Patterns Multipliers, Interest and end-of-Round/Deadline tickets, plus 2 free restocks per Deadline, but doubles 666 chance.

synergies.why: Cheap insurance against the doubled 666 chance.
More 666s to trigger it, and its x2 stacks with Evil Deal's.

summary: Patterns Multiplier +1 for each Red Call you turn down at the phone; tops out at +3 once Sacred Mode kicks in.

assumptions: Assumed Red Calls refused before you bought it also count (run-wide total, like the strikes on the 666 Disk).
cap 3: after 3 refused Red Calls the phone turns Sacred and Red Calls stop (wiki note).

summary: Takes no space: instantly refills the store with Symbol Pictures, using normal charms for any boxes left over.
